package service

import (
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type RoadmapCalculationInput struct {
	PracticeTask           domain.PracticeTask
	PracticeTaskMilestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone
	MilestoneKinds         map[string]domain.MilestoneKind
	MilestoneSkillTags     []domain.MilestoneKindSkillTag
	LessonSkillTags        []domain.LessonSkillTag
	TaskSkillTags          []domain.TaskSkillTag
	StudentPracticeTask    *domain.StudentPracticeTask
	StudentMilestones      []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone
	CompletedLessonIDs     map[string]struct{}
}

func CalculateRoadmap(input RoadmapCalculationInput) domain.Roadmap {
	skillTagsByKind := make(map[string][]string)
	for _, item := range input.MilestoneSkillTags {
		skillTagsByKind[item.MilestoneKindCode] = append(skillTagsByKind[item.MilestoneKindCode], item.SkillTagCode)
	}

	studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID := make(map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone)
	for _, item := range input.StudentMilestones {
		studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID[item.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID] = item
	}

	stackSkillSets := make(map[string]map[string]struct{})
	stackLessonSets := make(map[string]map[string]struct{})
	stackTaskSets := make(map[string]map[string]struct{})
	stackRequiredLessonUnits := make(map[string]map[string]bool)
	stackRecommendedLessonSets := make(map[string]map[string]struct{})
	stackOptionalLessonSets := make(map[string]map[string]struct{})
	milestoneLessonSets := make(map[string]map[string]struct{})
	milestoneTaskSets := make(map[string]map[string]struct{})

	for _, milestone := range input.PracticeTaskMilestones {
		if !milestone.IsActive {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := stackSkillSets[milestone.StackCode]; !ok {
			stackSkillSets[milestone.StackCode] = map[string]struct{}{}
			stackLessonSets[milestone.StackCode] = map[string]struct{}{}
			stackTaskSets[milestone.StackCode] = map[string]struct{}{}
			stackRequiredLessonUnits[milestone.StackCode] = map[string]bool{}
			stackRecommendedLessonSets[milestone.StackCode] = map[string]struct{}{}
			stackOptionalLessonSets[milestone.StackCode] = map[string]struct{}{}
		}
		if _, ok := milestoneLessonSets[milestone.ID]; !ok {
			milestoneLessonSets[milestone.ID] = map[string]struct{}{}
			milestoneTaskSets[milestone.ID] = map[string]struct{}{}
		}
		if len(milestone.LessonBindings) > 0 {
			for _, binding := range sortedLessonBindings(milestone.LessonBindings) {
				milestoneLessonSets[milestone.ID][binding.LessonID] = struct{}{}
				_, completed := input.CompletedLessonIDs[binding.LessonID]
				switch binding.Requirement {
				case domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRecommended:
					stackRecommendedLessonSets[milestone.StackCode][binding.LessonID] = struct{}{}
				case domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementOptional:
					stackOptionalLessonSets[milestone.StackCode][binding.LessonID] = struct{}{}
				default:
					unit := "lesson:" + binding.LessonID
					if binding.AlternativeGroup != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*binding.AlternativeGroup) != "" {
						unit = "alternative:" + milestone.ID + ":" + strings.TrimSpace(*binding.AlternativeGroup)
					}
					stackRequiredLessonUnits[milestone.StackCode][unit] = stackRequiredLessonUnits[milestone.StackCode][unit] || completed
				}
			}
		} else {
			for _, skillCode := range skillTagsByKind[milestone.MilestoneKindCode] {
				stackSkillSets[milestone.StackCode][skillCode] = struct{}{}
				for _, lessonTag := range input.LessonSkillTags {
					if lessonTag.SkillTagCode == skillCode {
						stackLessonSets[milestone.StackCode][lessonTag.LessonID] = struct{}{}
						milestoneLessonSets[milestone.ID][lessonTag.LessonID] = struct{}{}
						_, completed := input.CompletedLessonIDs[lessonTag.LessonID]
						stackRequiredLessonUnits[milestone.StackCode]["lesson:"+lessonTag.LessonID] = completed
					}
				}
				for _, taskTag := range input.TaskSkillTags {
					if taskTag.SkillTagCode == skillCode {
						stackTaskSets[milestone.StackCode][taskTag.TaskID] = struct{}{}
						milestoneTaskSets[milestone.ID][taskTag.TaskID] = struct{}{}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	var roadmap domain.Roadmap
	roadmap.PracticeTaskID = input.PracticeTask.ID
	if input.StudentPracticeTask != nil {
		roadmap.StudentPracticeTaskID = &input.StudentPracticeTask.ID
	}

	for _, milestone := range SortMilestonesForStudent(input.PracticeTaskMilestones) {
		if !milestone.IsActive {
			continue
		}
		status := domain.StudentMilestoneStatusNotStarted
		if studentMilestone, ok := studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID[milestone.ID]; ok {
			status = studentMilestone.Status
		}
		if roadmap.CurrentMilestoneID == nil && status != domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed && status != domain.StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped {
			roadmap.CurrentMilestoneID = &milestone.ID
		}
		lessonIDs := sortedKeys(milestoneLessonSets[milestone.ID])
		roadmap.Milestones = append(roadmap.Milestones, domain.RoadmapMilestone{
			ID:                             milestone.ID,
			PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID: milestone.ID,
			PracticeTaskMilestoneID:        milestone.PracticeTaskMilestoneID,
			PracticeTaskPartID:             milestone.PracticeTaskPartID,
			MilestoneKindCode:              milestone.MilestoneKindCode,
			StackCode:                      milestone.StackCode,
			StackCodes:                     append([]string(nil), milestone.StackCodes...),
			Title:                          milestone.Title,
			Status:                         domain.RoadmapStatusLabel(status),
			RequiredSkillTags:              sortedKeys(stackSubset(skillTagsByKind[milestone.MilestoneKindCode])),
			LessonIDs:                      lessonIDs,
			Lessons:                        roadmapLessons(milestone, lessonIDs, input.CompletedLessonIDs),
			TaskIDs:                        sortedKeys(milestoneTaskSets[milestone.ID]),
		})
	}

	stackOrder := orderedStacks(input.PracticeTask)
	if len(stackOrder) == 0 {
		stackOrder = deriveStacksFromMilestones(input.PracticeTaskMilestones)
	}
	for _, stackCode := range stackOrder {
		requiredCount := len(stackRequiredLessonUnits[stackCode])
		completed := 0
		for _, satisfied := range stackRequiredLessonUnits[stackCode] {
			if satisfied {
				completed++
			}
		}
		roadmap.Stacks = append(roadmap.Stacks, domain.RoadmapStack{
			StackCode:               stackCode,
			RequiredSkillTags:       sortedKeys(stackSkillSets[stackCode]),
			RequiredLessonsCount:    requiredCount,
			CompletedLessonsCount:   completed,
			RemainingLessonsCount:   requiredCount - completed,
			RequiredTasksCount:      len(stackTaskSets[stackCode]),
			RecommendedLessonsCount: len(stackRecommendedLessonSets[stackCode]),
			OptionalLessonsCount:    len(stackOptionalLessonSets[stackCode]),
		})
	}

	return roadmap
}

func roadmapLessons(milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, fallbackLessonIDs []string, completedLessonIDs map[string]struct{}) []domain.RoadmapLesson {
	if len(milestone.LessonBindings) > 0 {
		result := make([]domain.RoadmapLesson, 0, len(milestone.LessonBindings))
		for _, binding := range sortedLessonBindings(milestone.LessonBindings) {
			_, completed := completedLessonIDs[binding.LessonID]
			result = append(result, domain.RoadmapLesson{
				CourseID:          binding.CourseID,
				LessonID:          binding.LessonID,
				Requirement:       binding.Requirement,
				SortOrder:         binding.SortOrder,
				PrerequisiteGroup: binding.PrerequisiteGroup,
				AlternativeGroup:  binding.AlternativeGroup,
				StepTitle:         binding.StepTitle,
				StepInstructions:  binding.StepInstructions,
				Completed:         completed,
			})
		}
		return result
	}
	result := make([]domain.RoadmapLesson, 0, len(fallbackLessonIDs))
	for index, lessonID := range fallbackLessonIDs {
		_, completed := completedLessonIDs[lessonID]
		result = append(result, domain.RoadmapLesson{
			LessonID:    lessonID,
			Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired,
			SortOrder:   index,
			Completed:   completed,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func sortedLessonBindings(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding) []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding {
	result := append([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding(nil), items...)
	sort.SliceStable(result, func(left, right int) bool {
		if result[left].SortOrder == result[right].SortOrder {
			return result[left].LessonID < result[right].LessonID
		}
		return result[left].SortOrder < result[right].SortOrder
	})
	return result
}

func SortMilestonesForStudent(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone {
	result := make([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, 0, len(items))
	result = append(result, items...)
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool {
		if result[left].PartSortOrder == result[right].PartSortOrder {
			if result[left].SortOrder == result[right].SortOrder {
				return result[left].Title < result[right].Title
			}
			return result[left].SortOrder < result[right].SortOrder
		}
		return result[left].PartSortOrder < result[right].PartSortOrder
	})
	return result
}

func orderedStacks(project domain.PracticeTask) []string {
	if len(project.Stacks) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	items := make([]domain.PracticeTaskStack, 0, len(project.Stacks))
	items = append(items, project.Stacks...)
	sort.Slice(items, func(left, right int) bool {
		if items[left].SortOrder == items[right].SortOrder {
			return items[left].StackCode < items[right].StackCode
		}
		return items[left].SortOrder < items[right].SortOrder
	})
	result := make([]string, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		result = append(result, item.StackCode)
	}
	return result
}

func deriveStacksFromMilestones(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) []string {
	set := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, item := range items {
		for _, stackCode := range item.StackCodes {
			if stackCode != "" {
				set[stackCode] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
		if item.StackCode != "" {
			set[item.StackCode] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	return sortedKeys(set)
}

func stackSubset(values []string) map[string]struct{} {
	result := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		result[value] = struct{}{}
	}
	return result
}

func sortedKeys(values map[string]struct{}) []string {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return []string{}
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for key := range values {
		result = append(result, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result
}
